description: Processes and transforms YAML, JSON, XML, TOML, and properties files using yq expressions. Accepts input from a file path or inline string. Returns the transformed result.

evalAll.description: Evaluate expression across all files (eval-all mode)

file.description: Path to an input file to process

files.description: Multiple file paths for eval-all mode (evaluates expression across all files)

inPlace.description: Edit file in-place (-i flag). DANGER: modifies the file. Requires explicit opt-in.

input.description: Inline YAML/JSON string to process (used when file is not provided)

inputFormat.description: Input format (-p flag). Defaults to yaml.

noColors.description: Disable color output (--no-colors / -M flag). Defaults to true.

nullInput.description: Don't read any input, useful for generating YAML from scratch (--null-input / -n)

outputFormat.description: Output format (-o flag). Defaults to yaml.

unwrapScalar.description: Unwrap scalar values (remove quotes from strings) (--unwrapScalar)

name: yq
title: YAML/JSON/XML/TOML Processor
